review_type: bounded independent source inspection and malformed-ID reproduction
reviewed_boundaries: Each member retains own publication, observation, enrichment and original expiry clocks.
Late corroborators cannot borrow an earlier member clock or renew another member expiry.
Exact syndicated headlines and duplicate publishers cannot add independent support.
Current guarded topic replay checks seal and public fields before fresh admission.
Current snapshot rejects missing proof and conflicting identities; exact duplicates collapse.
Current snapshot is bounded to 128 topics and 8 MiB, with source-as-of and actual postcompute generation.
Producer publishes exactly three implementation source hashes for adapter validation.

closed_findings.finding: Malformed list/dict event IDs could reach Counter as unhashable keys.
closed_findings.closure: Only string IDs enter duplicate counting; malformed IDs remain inadmissible context.
closed_findings.reproduction: Verified list-ID input returns member_no_eligible_contributors without exception.

limits: This review does not authenticate news truth or establish trading profitability.
Adapter source-binding, retained history and exact capture integration are reviewed separately.
No pytest case count is attributed to this review; producer owner records its own test suite.
